design.capacity_gap_semantics: When a sub-plate exceeds 3000 rows, its first 100 pages (latest 3000 rows) are ingested, the shortfall is recorded per partition, the run terminates degraded with terminal_diagnostics cninfo_partition_capacity_gap, and the closed date's checkpoint STILL advances. Reconciliation requires sum(partition totals) == aggregate and unique rows + gap rows == aggregate; a capped partition must have seen exactly 3000 rows with total > 3000, otherwise it is a partition_count_mismatch failure.
design.what_downstream_must_do: Treat dates listed in daily_checkpoint.capacity_gap_dates_shanghai (and slices with capacity_gap=true) as missing coverage for the listed partitions, never as 'no events'.
